---
title: "Pipeline skills"
---

A pipeline skill is a tested script that Claude runs instead of writing new
code for a standard analysis. The design ports
[ClawBio](https://github.com/ClawBio/ClawBio)'s determinism framework: the
skill is a contract, and the agent dispatches it without improvising.

## What every skill guarantees

- **No analysis defaults.** Thresholds, designs, gene sets and seeds are
  required arguments. Claude asks you for each one. `--demo` alone pins
  demo-only values.
- **Context travels with the result.** A required `--context` (species,
  tissue or cell type, condition, dataset) opens every report and summary.
- **Fixed failures.** Bad input prints `ERROR: <message>` and exits 2, with no
  traceback.
- **Required checks.** Duplicate ids, a rank-deficient design, and several
  samples per donor with no donor term all stop the run.
- **Gene ids kept.** Gene tables carry `gene_id` beside `gene_symbol`. An
  ambiguous symbol-to-id map stops the run. Use `--gene-id-col none` when the
  data have symbols only.
- **Nothing silently dropped.** Per-feature tables keep every input feature,
  with a `status` column: `tested`, `not_tested`, `not_detected`,
  `below_detection` or `not_measured`.
- **A fixed output tree.**

```
outdir/
├── report.md              # context, parameters, summary, figures with captions
├── result.json            # summary fields, chat_summary_lines, preferred_artifacts
├── tables/*.tsv
├── data/*.h5ad            # objects the next skill reads
├── figures/<name>.{pdf,png,csv}
└── reproducibility/
    ├── commands.sh        # the resolved command, every argument
    ├── environment.txt    # package versions
    └── checksums.sha256   # sha256sum -c from outdir
```

## Catalogue

Each skill hands off to the next through its output tables or h5ad.

### Single-cell preprocessing

| Skill | Does | Engine |
|---|---|---|
| [sc-qc](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-coder/blob/main/skills/sc-qc/SKILL.md) | Per-cell QC metrics, Scrublet doublets, fixed or MAD thresholds | scanpy |
| [sc-normalize](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-coder/blob/main/skills/sc-normalize/SKILL.md) | log1p, Pearson residuals, or dsb for ADT | scanpy, muon |
| [sc-embed](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-coder/blob/main/skills/sc-embed/SKILL.md) | HVG, PCA, optional Harmony, kNN, UMAP, Leiden | scanpy |
| [sc-annotate](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-coder/blob/main/skills/sc-annotate/SKILL.md) | Label transfer with CellTypist or ingest | CellTypist, scanpy |
| [sc-markers](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-coder/blob/main/skills/sc-markers/SKILL.md) | Marker genes per cluster with a fixed pass rule | scanpy |

### Differential expression and abundance

| Skill | Does | Engine |
|---|---|---|
| [pseudobulk-de](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-coder/blob/main/skills/pseudobulk-de/SKILL.md) | Sum counts per sample, then DESeq2, or dreamlet for repeated measures | PyDESeq2, DESeq2, dreamlet |
| [sc-de](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-coder/blob/main/skills/sc-de/SKILL.md) | MAST hurdle model per cell type, or a per-feature linear model on sample values | MAST, R `lm` |
| [variance-partition](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-coder/blob/main/skills/variance-partition/SKILL.md) | Variance fractions per gene across covariates | variancePartition |
| [mashr-sharing](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-coder/blob/main/skills/mashr-sharing/SKILL.md) | Shared and specific effects across cell types | mashr |
| [composition](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-coder/blob/main/skills/composition/SKILL.md) | Cell-type composition with crumblr CLR and dream | crumblr |
| [milo-da](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-coder/blob/main/skills/milo-da/SKILL.md) | Neighbourhood differential abundance on the kNN graph | pertpy Milo |

### Scores, pathways and programs

| Skill | Does | Engine |
|---|---|---|
| [enrichment](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-coder/blob/main/skills/enrichment/SKILL.md) | Preranked fgsea or over-representation on DE tables | fgsea, scipy |
| [signature-scoring](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-coder/blob/main/skills/signature-scoring/SKILL.md) | Gene-set scores per cell, with a size-matched random control | scanpy, decoupler |
| [tf-activity](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-coder/blob/main/skills/tf-activity/SKILL.md) | TF or pathway activity from CollecTRI or PROGENy | decoupler |
| [gene-programs](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-coder/blob/main/skills/gene-programs/SKILL.md) | Consensus NMF gene programs | scikit-learn |
| [ccc](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-coder/blob/main/skills/ccc/SKILL.md) | Ligand-receptor communication between cell types | LIANA+ |

### Dynamics and integration

| Skill | Does | Engine |
|---|---|---|
| [trajectory](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-coder/blob/main/skills/trajectory/SKILL.md) | PAGA and diffusion pseudotime from a fixed root | scanpy |
| [velocity](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-coder/blob/main/skills/velocity/SKILL.md) | RNA velocity and fate probabilities | scVelo, CellRank 2 |
| [mofa](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-coder/blob/main/skills/mofa/SKILL.md) | Multi-omics factor analysis across views | mofapy2 |

### Sample-level statistics

| Skill | Does | Engine |
|---|---|---|
| [group-tests](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-coder/blob/main/skills/group-tests/SKILL.md) | Wilcoxon, paired, Spearman or Pearson per feature, with effect sizes | scipy |
| [longitudinal](https://github.com/mdmanurung/lucid-coder/blob/main/skills/longitudinal/SKILL.md) | One mixed model per feature over visits | lmerTest |

## Running a skill yourself

Claude normally runs the skill for you. To run one by hand, use the `uv run`
line from the skill's `references/maintainer.md`:

```bash
cd skills/pseudobulk-de
uv run --python 3.12 --with anndata,numpy,pandas,scipy,matplotlib,plotnine-extra,pydeseq2 \
  python scripts/pseudobulk_de.py --demo --outdir /tmp/pbde-demo
cd /tmp/pbde-demo && sha256sum -c reproducibility/checksums.sha256
```

Skills with an R engine (composition, variance-partition, mashr-sharing,
longitudinal, enrichment's fgsea, sc-de, pseudobulk-de's DESeq2 and
dreamlet) need `Rscript` on `PATH` or in `RSCRIPT`, with the R packages
installed. The skill never installs them.
